//: The npm test wall-time budget of docs/STORE-SAAS.md §J.1 (rev 5, CRIT2-9) as data: seconds on the owner's PC per group, read by scripts/qa/test-budget.ts. The sum of a release's groups must not exceed its ceiling and must equal its declared total; a group's scripts are the §J.1 / §J.6 rows its track owns. A release with `extends` adds its groups to that release's. `measuredSec` is the group's time in the last timed run (`npm run test:budget`) that re-cut the table; the static check refuses a share below it. Maintainer-owned (§K.3): a part changes its share through a CCR. Re-cut at P0 (review G7, CCR r1.0-c0b-3 items 2 and 3) from the timed run of 2026-10-28 on the owner's PC (heavy mutex held, 1.7 GB free): existing 88.5 s, core 63.0 s, then 46.1 s once test:prepublish's ar fixtures and lock child processes moved to test:slow; the R1 ceiling is raised from 180 s to 240 s and the track shares cut to fit (the declared 175 s could not hold the 150 s the two maintainer groups measure).
